name: @forest/e2e
description: Forest end to end: two people from two seeds, each with a stamp from the loop's verifier kept in their Profiles folder and asked back by its stamp number, and its welcome gift of host credits, collected with the sponsor's ticket; a profile entry carrying a real verification and pay { solana, evm }; each person's AI logging in through the connect page, where the reference app makes its connection folder, with an access key, and hands the mcp a pointer to it, then writing, searching, messaging and reading the inbox through the mcp, and a review written by the AI; the loop's index counting it all and serving what each profile shows, its ratings, trust and uniqueness, signed; the tutor carrying its trust to a second profile with a reputation proof, added to its AI's connection with no new login; the connection ended and the AI's next call refused; and a new device finding the profiles from the seed. The loop's own verifier, host, index and mcp, on loopback from this repo, with no chain and no secret; or the deployed check, that each service a services.json names answers.
